HandleKick: four-unit pushes for five ticks in twenty; kick target stops pushing rather than clamping.
StartGrind (810-868): mRailDir * (speedStat+5) impulse, then projection in DoOnRailPhysics.

game/data/unnamed.cpp: Tony base stats 3/7/7/4 and first stat upgrade +1 to each stat.

copingDeparture.correction: On source-profile levels only, an unjumped departure within existing ground grace can cross coping. Jumped landings, later falls and ordinary bars retain rail-smack behavior.

Existing level retains its contact rule

limitations: Continuous 60 Hz movement with native 30 Hz balance/rail-assist decisions; not every original fixed-point operation or rail-node substep position.

Balance recurrence matches the compiled source for the same native state/input/random stream. Production uses the fork deterministic RNG and post-step state sampling; transition-boundary timing and the original global random sequence are not frame-exact.
Original kick-animation gating and temporary crouched-target decay remain unimplemented.
Steering, braking, ground-contact tracking, special-mode bonuses and terrain-specific friction remain to be compared.

Rail candidate geometry now uses source integer line-pair and endpoint/ground-side rules, but queries the preceding 60 Hz step rather than the source 30 Hz scheduled offer. Full trick/handplant eligibility, snap placement/easing and node substep timing remain fork adaptations. Under-rail hangs and perfect-grind rewards remain fork extensions.
Directional rail exits use the source angle in the local rail plane, with the prototype camera-relative input convention.
Charged-pose calibration is supported; coasting pose and cruiser proportions differ from the source actor.
correctionToPass22: mMaxSpeed remains a drag threshold, but DoPhysics has a separate MAXSPEED(50) full-vector cap. The previous 55 m/s no-clamp expectation was incomplete; pass 23 verifies drag at 45 m/s and the final cap at 55 m/s and during a fast fall.
configurationNote: Tony base ollie/speed/air/balance is 3/7/7/4; the selected 4/8/8/5 includes his first STAT UPGRADE (+1 each), not a zero-bonus starting board. This corrects the earlier first-board label without changing the existing movement stats.
